snippet.title: MOTORFISH - Alpha 1.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE GAME - https://retrocrow.itch.io/motorfish

MOTORFISH is a game about a catfish with a motor-powered tail and a gun. 
This is my first real video game and I've put hours and hours of work into it. Give it a shot - it's free!

This is NOT a return to youtube, at least for now. I'm uploading this here so you can see what I'm doing now that I'm (probably) done with youtube.
I hope you guys enjoy MOTORFISH!
#retrocrow #motorfish
